note: Reference data comes from Artificial Analysis's own leaderboard data (read directly, last on 2026-11-09): every model scoring 25 or more on its Intelligence Index, at its best effort setting, with AA's evaluations, prices, output speed and cost and time per task. A scraper also searches English and Chinese news every six hours for releases AA has not measured yet; those numbers only appear here after review. The AA Coding and Agentic indexes and some provider prices are earlier hand entries from aggregators (temperature2.com, multiple.chat). Blank cells are not observed; every number carries its source and effort setting on hover.

benchmarks.name: AA Intelligence Index
benchmarks.blurb: One number over a fixed suite of benchmarks run by Artificial Analysis rather than the model vendors; higher is better.

benchmarks.name: AA Coding Index
benchmarks.blurb: Artificial Analysis composite for coding tasks as shown by one aggregator; its component tests are not recorded yet.

benchmarks.name: AA Agentic Index
benchmarks.blurb: Artificial Analysis composite for multi-step agentic tasks as shown by one aggregator; its component tests are not recorded yet.

benchmarks.name: AA Cost per task
benchmarks.blurb: USD Artificial Analysis spent running its task suite on this model at the stated effort setting; lower is cheaper. It reflects how many tokens the model uses, not only its price per token.

benchmarks.name: AA Time per task
benchmarks.blurb: Minutes the same suite took end to end at the stated effort setting; lower is faster.

benchmarks.name: AA First answer token
benchmarks.blurb: Seconds until the first token of the final answer arrives, after any reasoning; lower is quicker. High-effort reasoning modes can take minutes.

benchmarks.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.blurb: 198 graduate-level science questions written to resist web search.

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam
benchmarks.blurb: 2,500 expert-written questions across maths, science and the humanities.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2025
benchmarks.blurb: Competition mathematics problems from the 2025 American Invitational Mathematics Examination.

benchmarks.name: MMLU-Pro
benchmarks.blurb: A harder, ten-option version of the MMLU general-knowledge multiple-choice test.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.blurb: Novel grid puzzles that test reasoning on tasks the model has not seen.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.blurb: Real GitHub issues a model must fix so the project's tests pass; human-verified subset.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Pro
benchmarks.blurb: A harder, less contaminated set of software-engineering issues than SWE-bench Verified.

benchmarks.name: LiveCodeBench
benchmarks.blurb: Fresh competitive-programming problems released after model training cutoffs.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench
benchmarks.blurb: Multi-step tasks completed in a real command-line environment.

benchmarks.name: Context window
benchmarks.blurb: Longest input the model accepts, in thousands of tokens, as listed by Artificial Analysis.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
benchmarks.blurb: Multi-step tasks in a real command-line environment, run by Artificial Analysis; % solved.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench
benchmarks.blurb: Artificial Analysis's business-automation tasks across tools and apps; partial-credit score in %.

benchmarks.name: AA-Briefcase
benchmarks.blurb: Agentic knowledge work (analyst-style briefs) judged head to head; an Elo rating, higher is better.

benchmarks.name: FrontierCode 2.0
benchmarks.blurb: Hard, recent software-engineering tasks; % solved.

benchmarks.name: SciCode
benchmarks.blurb: Scientific programming problems from research code; % of sub-problems solved.

benchmarks.name: HLE-Diamond
benchmarks.blurb: The hardest verified subset of Humanity's Last Exam; % correct.

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam
benchmarks.blurb: 2,500 expert-written questions across maths, science and the humanities; % correct.

benchmarks.name: CritPt v2 (hard)
benchmarks.blurb: Research-level physics problems, hard subset; % correct.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench Science
benchmarks.blurb: Scientific computing tasks in a terminal; % solved.

benchmarks.name: Long-context reasoning
benchmarks.blurb: Artificial Analysis's reasoning questions over very long documents; % correct.

benchmarks.name: GDP.pdf
benchmarks.blurb: Answering questions from long economic PDF reports; % fully correct.

benchmarks.name: MMMU-Pro
benchmarks.blurb: College-level questions that need images and text together; % correct.

benchmarks.name: AA-Omniscience
benchmarks.blurb: Knowledge reliability: correct answers minus hallucinations, -100 to 100; refusing costs nothing.

benchmarks.name: Non-hallucination rate
benchmarks.blurb: Share of AA-Omniscience questions it did not answer wrongly (100 minus the hallucination rate); %.
